description: This file defines a PHP trait 'EmployeeOnLeaveServiceTrait' within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin. The trait provides a method to access the 'EmployeeOnLeaveService' from the ServiceContainer, facilitating dependency injection and service retrieval within classes that use this trait.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeOnLeaveService by retrieving it from the container.
